overview: A family-friendly island escape across Port Blair, Havelock and Neil — white-sand beaches, the historic Cellular Jail, and scenic island ferries.
highlights: Port Blair to Havelock — Elephant Beach & Radhanagar Beach
Havelock to Neil Island — Bharatpur Beach, Natural Rock Bridge & Laxmanpur Beach
Neil Island to Port Blair — Marina Park & local sightseeing

itinerary.title: Port Blair arrival — Cellular Jail, Corbyn's Cove Beach & Light and Sound Show
Port Blair to Havelock — Elephant Beach & Radhanagar Beach
Havelock to Neil Island — Bharatpur Beach, Natural Rock Bridge & Laxmanpur Beach
Neil Island to Port Blair — Marina Park & local sightseeing

inclusions: Accommodation in rooms as given at hotels in Port Blair--Havelock on Double basis with breakfast.
Daily breakfast & Dinner except on day of arrival.
Sightseeing in private air-conditioned vehicle as per the itinerary Only--including Airport Pick up and drop.
Entry Tickets, Permit Fees, Boat/ Ferry Tickets, to visit all the places of sightseeing is inclusive in the package cost.
24 hours on call assistance during your stay
Travel assistance by Yana Travels Experts in all the islands.
If your trip begins early morning, a packed breakfast will be provided from the the hotel.
The field executive will provide travel assistance at all the major entry and exit points (Airport,
Jetty, Jail, Water sports complex, Havelock, Neil, etc.)
All dedicated vehicle charges (Toyota Rumion/Ertiga/Xylo/Scorpio N/Tata Winger) as per itinerary in AC and not at disposal.
exclusions: Overland Journey which is not mentioned in the Itinerary.
Any Medical/rescue evacuation due to mishaps
Any extra excursion or sightseeing apart from suggested tour itinerary.
Cost incidental to any change in the itinerary/ stay on account of flight cancellation due to bad weather
Roadblocks and/or any factors beyond control
Anything not mentioned in the inclusions is excluded.
